_meta.title: Spaceship Combat System - Data Design
_meta.notes: Schemas define structure/types. 'example*' objects show real instances following the schema.

shipSchema.name: string
shipSchema.shipClass: enum: scout | frigate | cruiser | battleship | carrier | freighter

mass.note: Affects acceleration, turn rate, and weapon slot capacity limits

hull.armorRating: number, flat damage reduction applied after shields are down

hardpoints.description: Weapon mounting slots. Count and size scale with shipClass/mass.

moduleSlots.description: Non-weapon systems: engines, shield boosters, ECM, repair drones, cargo, etc.

list.slotType: enum: engine | utility | defensive | sensor | cargo

componentHitpoints.description: Subsystems that can be targeted/critically hit independently of overall hull HP.

mobility.evasionRating: number 0-1, base chance to avoid being hit, scales inversely with mass

crew.gunnerySkill: number 0-100, affects weapon accuracy and fire rate
crew.engineeringSkill: number 0-100, affects repair speed and power management

power.note: Weapons/shields/engines draw power; allocation can be shifted between them each turn

weaponSchema.name: string
weaponSchema.weaponClass: enum: kinetic | energy | missile | mine | melee

damage.variance: number, +/- random spread applied per shot

accuracy.tracking: number, ability to hit fast/small targets

fireRate.cooldownTurns: number after volley before it can fire again

weaponSchema.powerCost: number, drawn from ship power pool per shot
weaponSchema.ammo: number or 'infinite', for missiles/kinetics with physical rounds
weaponSchema.criticalChance: number 0-1, chance to roll on component-critical table

moduleSchema.name: string
moduleSchema.moduleType: enum: engine | shieldBooster | ecm | ecCounterElectronics | repairDrone | cargoExpander | armorPlating | powerCore

effect.stat: string, which ship stat this modifies
effect.modifier: number, flat or percentage per moduleSchema.modifierType

moduleSchema.powerCost: number, passive power draw per turn

turnStructure: 1. Initiative: sort all ships by (pilotSkill + sensorArray_bonus + random d20) descending.
2. Power allocation phase: each ship (or AI) assigns currentPower budget across weapons/shields/engines for this turn.
3. Movement phase: ships resolve movement/positioning based on mobility stats; determines range bands to targets.
4. Targeting phase: each ship selects target ship and optionally a target component (bridge, engines, etc).
5. Fire resolution phase: process weapon fire in initiative order using hitChanceFormula and damageFormula.
6. Damage application: apply to shields first (if shieldType matches/absorbs), then hull, then component HP if targeted.
7. Critical check: if a hit's roll qualifies, roll on componentCriticalTable.
8. End of turn: shields recharge (if not in rechargeDelay window), repair modules apply, check destruction/retreat conditions.

damageFormula.vsArmor: hullDamage = max(1, rawDamage - hull.armorRating), applied only after shields.currentHP reaches 0
damageFormula.overkillCarryover: any damage exceeding shields.currentHP in a single hit carries over to hull in the same hit, minus armorRating

specialEffectOverrides.ignores_shields_partial: 50% of rawDamage bypasses shields directly to hull
specialEffectOverrides.armor_piercing: armorRating reduction is halved when calculating vsArmor

componentTargetingRules.description: Attacker may choose to target a specific component instead of general hull.
componentTargetingRules.note: Component HP depletion triggers criticalEffect immediately; component damage does NOT subtract from hull HP pool separately, it is a parallel tracked pool representing subsystem integrity.

componentCriticalTable.trigger: weapon.criticalChance check on any successful hit, roll d100

outcomes.result: minor system damage, -10% to a random stat for 2 turns
targeted component takes 25% of its maxHP as bonus damage
targeted component (or random if none chosen) disabled for 1 turn
catastrophic critical: component destroyed, permanent effect until repaired in dock

shieldRechargeRules.amountPerTurn: shields.rechargeRatePerTurn, modified by any equipped shieldBooster module

destructionConditions: hull.currentHP <= 0 -> ship destroyed, explosion may damage nearby ships
lifeSupport component destroyed AND currentCrew reaches 0 -> ship destroyed (crew loss)
optional surrender/retreat: hull.currentHP < 15% of maxHP AND no weapons operational -> AI may attempt retreat
victoryConditions: all enemy ships destroyed or retreated
objective-based: e.g. escort survives N turns, or capital ship reaches waypoint
